source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 5 May 1952, p. 4
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)

note: Triennial election of the 19 electoral divisions of Dungannon rural district, one member each, polled on 5 June 1952. Twelve Unionists and five Nationalists were returned unopposed; Crossdernott and Coalisland were contested. The new council had thirteen Unionists and six Nationalists, with three members to be co-opted. Of The Bawn; in place of Mr. Thomas Curry. Returned unopposed.
